questions.question: Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term. 29 : 61 :: 47 : ? :: 15 : 33 [SSC CPO 2024 Eng]
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.
29 : 61 :: 47 : ? :: 15 : 33
[SSC CPO 2024 Eng]
questions.solution:
Logic:

Second number= First number + (First number +3)

By same logic: 47 : ?

? = 47 + (47+3)

= 47+50

= 97
